preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 250,000 inclusive.
There are exactly n-1 edges provided.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and 1 <= w <= 1000000 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two valid vertices with a strictly positive integer weight up to 10^6.
The given edges form a connected graph without cycles (a tree).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(output_values[x] == min_deleted_weight(n, edges, x) for x in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each x from 0 to n-1, the x-th output value is the minimum total weight of edges to delete such that the maximum degree of any vertex in the remaining graph is at most x.

postconditions.expression: all(output_values[x] <= output_values[x-1] for x in range(1, n))
postconditions.description: The sequence of answers is non-increasing, as allowing higher degrees requires deleting fewer or equal weight edges.
